description: This file defines the PendingAppraisalReviewSummary class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's dashboard module. It implements an interface for action summaries related to pending appraisal reviews, encapsulating logic to count pending reviews for a specific employee.

classes.name: PendingAppraisalReviewSummary
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic for summarizing pending appraisal reviews for an employee, utilizing a filter parameters object and service traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with specific employee review filter parameters based on the employee number.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns a fixed group identifier for this summary type.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the display name of the group of pending reviews.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending appraisal reviews retrieved via the employee action summary service.
